messages:
marco_fin: Heads-up — HelioMetrics (acct 5521) pinged billing claiming unexpected spike and asked for a credit. They're currently past due.
rachel_acct_mgr: Confirmed. They sent a statement showing a Usage spike on 2026-02-28 that they say is from a load test by infra. Asking for $24,800 credit.
jenny_collections: What's the outstanding? Any partial payments?
marco_fin: Current ledger:
``
Invoice: HM-2026-5521
Period: 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28
Amount: $49,600.00
Payments: $10,000.00 (2026-03-05)
Balance: $39,600.00
Disputed amount requested: $24,800.00
``
ops-bot: Automated note: Account flagged for manual review. Service throttle = none. Scheduled dunning email stage 2 on 2026-03-18.
rachel_acct_mgr: They propose: we apply a provisional $20k credit, they pay $19,600 now, and we open a post-pay investigation to reconcile logs. They offered to sign an attestation about the load test.
jenny_collections: I need logs or evidence before giving credit. If we accept provisional credit, we should reduce cutoff window by 7 days and require an on-file ACH auth.
steve_cfo: I'm okay with a partial provisional credit up to $15k pending investigation, provided (1) they clear at least 50% of current balance today, (2) we get a recourse clause — credit is reversible if investigation shows no billing error, and (3) a deadline to complete investigation (30 days).
compliance-ops: Make sure attestation includes who ran the test, IP ranges, and whether any surge was related to paid feature flags. We'll need that for audit trail.
marco_fin: Proposed operational plan: A) Request HelioMetrics to pay $20k by EOD 2026-03-16. B) Apply provisional credit of $10k (pending logs) to reduce balance. C) Open internal ticket for revenue ops to reconcile within 30 days. D) If they don't pay by EOD, trigger dunning and schedule partial service throttle.
rachel_acct_mgr: I've messaged their billing lead and cc'd their CTO. They replied "we can do $20k today, will send attestation and logs by COB tomorrow."
jenny_collections: Good — if payment clears, I'll pause escalation and mark account as 'under review'. If payment fails, escalate to collections on 2026-03-17.
steve_cfo: OK proceed with plan but cap provisional credit at $10k. No waiving of late fees unless investigation confirms our error.
marco_fin: Noted. I'll prepare a short email template outlining the conditions (payment, attestation, 30-day investigation, reversible credit). Sending now.
ops-bot: Payment processing note: ACH incoming (expected) — if received, ledger auto-updates.
rachel_acct_mgr: Update: they've initiated ACH and uploaded attestation PDF.
marco_fin: Received confirmation of ACH initiation. Marking as awaiting settlement. Keeping thread open.
(reacts: :white_check_mark: from steve_cfo, :eyes: from compliance-ops)
